ScoreEntry.title: ScoreEntry
ScoreEntry.description: A recorded game score submitted by a player after finishing a round of Anime Guess or Sports Emoji Quiz.

playerName.description: Display name entered by the player when finishing the game.

score.description: Final points achieved in the game round.

game.description: Name of the quiz game played.

mode.description: Category/mode played within the game (e.g., Naruto, One Piece, Хөлбөмбөг).

categoryIcon.description: Emoji icon representing the selected mode.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the round.

won.description: Whether the player completed all questions without losing all lives.

authorId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who submitted the score.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was saved.

/scores/{scoreId}.description: Public leaderboard scores saved when players finish Anime Guess or Sports Emoji Quiz.
